name: Smoked Salmon Tartare
whyItWorks: Cured, finely chopped smoked salmon is butter-soft and packed with anti-inflammatory omega-3 fats with 0g plant fiber.
prepOrOrderInstructions: At Animator's Palate, order without whole capers, raw red onion, or lemon zest, and go light on the dill-caper sour cream (or pair with plain white dinner rolls).
watchOuts: Whole capers and raw minced red onion
Sour cream/crème fraîche if lactose sensitive
